sourcePassages.workAndClosure: Des travaux de réfection de la rue des Érables ainsi que la construction d’un poste de pompage nécessitent la fermeture temporaire du boulevard Saint-Jean-Baptiste à l’intersection de la route 138 et de la rue des Érables/William. Avec la mobilisation de l’entrepreneur, il y aura la mise en place de la signalisation et du réseau temporaire d’eau potable.

observations: The red star marks the closure and its legend reads « Fermeture boul. Saint-Jean-Baptiste/rue des Érables ».
The blue line legend reads « Chemin de détour »; the yellow line legend reads « Circulation locale seulement ».
The visual labels support the text's vehicle/truck detour distinction and local-only warning.
The image is an aerial schematic without published coordinates or a georeferenced road geometry; neither the star nor the colored routes are digitized.

review.decision: Keep in review; do not create a map record.
reasons: The page's work period gives month, day, and time but no year, so exact dates and active/future eligibility are not established.
The page says the work may be postponed, prolonged, or cancelled and does not state that the closure is currently active.
The notice and image identify an intersection and show a symbolic star, but publish no coordinates, scale, or road geometry; no trace can be digitized or guessed.
The published text and image give detour descriptions, not closure geometries; detours must not be drawn as closed roads.

extraction.method: Chromium capture of the official HTML index and all linked notices; original notice media fetched and fingerprinted for review.
limitations: The official site currently exposes notices as HTML rather than a structured roadwork and geometry feed.
The reviewed image distinguishes the closure marker and detour/local-traffic routes but is not georeferenced; its pixels are not converted into road geometry.
The notice remains a review candidate until its work year, current/future status, and independently verifiable geometry are established.
